darwin.notes: macOS 1.2.5 build 132: fixes Project / EXACT FILES scope, search delays during audio analysis, and offline library status after reconnecting a drive. Adds clickable shortcut-bar entries that open matching Instructions, plus optional hover hints. Also includes REX preview and editing, RX2 drag export, vertical waveform zoom, and Project Audio Export.

win32.notes: Windows 1.2.5 build 263: adds REX loop preview and editing, RX2 loop/trim drag export, Project Audio Export to a folder or ZIP, per-preview waveform zoom, and Ogg audio in WAV. Improves large-library navigation and adds FFmpeg LGPL attribution in About. Fixes EXACT FILES in Projects: duplicate results stay scoped to the selected Project, and turning the filter off restores its files. Fixes search and library switching delayed by audio analysis and shows when results are loading.
